description: Official dragon-tiger list (龙虎榜) for one trading day, ranked by top-five seats' net buying: brokerage branches, institutional seats (机构专用) and northbound desks. **Published the evening after the close — during trading hours it returns the PREVIOUS trading day**; always state the response's `trade_date`. Check `coverage` per exchange (`complete` / `complete_empty` / `pending` / `failed`) before concluding a name is absent. A name can appear once per qualifying reason (`reason_category`) — do not dedupe. ⚠️ `net_buy_cny` nets the top-five DISCLOSED seats only; not comparable with moneyflow. ⚠️ Totals aggregate each side's OWN list, whereas vendors aggregate over the UNION of both lists, so vendor totals run larger — reconcile on `seats[]`, not on totals, and do not report the gap as a data error. ⚠️ Shanghai (incl. STAR) discloses one side per seat: `sell_cny = null` on a buy-side seat means NOT DISCLOSED, not zero. Prefer the precomputed `institution_net_cny` / `has_northbound`. Amounts CNY, ratios percentage points.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

category.description: Filter by qualifying reason: deviation_up/deviation_down (daily move deviation), turnover, amplitude, three_day_deviation_up/down (3-day cumulative), consecutive_limit, abnormal_severe, st_risk, new_listing, no_limit, other

date.description: Trading day YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the latest day that has data (during trading hours that is the previous trading day).

inst_only.description: Only rows whose BUY side contains an institutional seat (机构专用).

kind.description: Security kind; defaults to stock (B shares / funds / convertibles excluded).

northbound.description: Only rows where a northbound (沪深股通) seat appears on either side.

sort.description: Sort key and direction (default net_buy_desc): net_buy / pct_change / amount / buy_total / sell_total / institution_net, each _desc or _asc. Rows with no value for the chosen field always sort LAST, ascending included — an ascending page of nulls would look like the smallest names when it is really just the ones with no data.

name: dragon_tiger_daily
